normative_extracts.quote: An upgrade transaction cannot start until all other open connections to the same database are closed; if any remain open, a blocked event is fired.
The versionchange event is fired on open database connections when a new connection attempts to upgrade the database version.

engine_internals.mechanism_summary: Coordinates cross-tab database handle closure via onversionchange so an atomic versionchange transaction can apply sequential schema steps.

production_failures.symptom: App stays stuck on loading spinner whenever user opens a second tab after a release
production_failures.root_cause: Tab 1 held an open IndexedDB v1 connection without an onversionchange handler, blocking Tab 2's v2 open() request indefinitely.
production_failures.mitigation: Attach db.onversionchange = () => db.close() on every connection and prompt or reload Tab 1.

production_failures.symptom: Migration throws TransactionInactiveError mid-upgrade and rolls back all stores
production_failures.root_cause: Migration script awaited a Promise (fetch or setTimeout) inside onupgradeneeded, causing IndexedDB to auto-commit the versionchange transaction.
production_failures.mitigation: Keep onupgradeneeded strictly synchronous over IDBRequests; run async data backfills in a separate readwrite transaction after open() resolves.
